lieu: courtyard of a house in Treichville, Abidjan, plastic chairs in a circle, a small table with a metal cash box and a notebook, afternoon

persos.nom: the tontine president with the notebook
persos.desc: tontine president in her 50s, ochre-and-black wax kaba, big round glasses, holding a notebook
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding the notebook, very serious

persos.desc: member in her 30s, pink-and-gold head tie, sky-blue jumpsuit with a white belt, a small purse
persos.pose: standing in the middle, hands open, confused

persos.nom: the treasurer with the cash box
persos.desc: treasurer in her 40s, emerald-green kaftan with gold trim, hands on the metal cash box
persos.pose: sitting at the small table on the right, both hands on the cash box, glaring

dialogue: Ma sœur, on t'a renvoyée de la tontine des femmes mariées dêh !
Oui, mais avec le mari de la trésorière-là.
Rembourse mes cotisations et le monsieur dêh !
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The president announces it very seriously. The member protests, hands open. The president answers calmly, pointing her pen at the treasurer. The treasurer, seated, slams one hand on the cash box and shouts, her face clearly visible.
chute: The member freezes, her mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the member's busted face looking into the camera.
gag: LE MARI QUAND IL VA RENTRER CE SOIR :

lieu: living room of a house in Abobo, Abidjan, an empty TV stand with dangling cables, a big empty cardboard TV box on the floor, a sofa, evening

persos.nom: the furious father pointing at the TV stand
persos.desc: father in his 50s, grey beard, ivory singlet, a long blue-and-white checkered sarong
persos.pose: standing next to the empty TV stand, pointing at it, furious

persos.nom: the calm son with the box
persos.desc: young man around 20, black hoodie with a big orange star, sneakers, hands resting on the empty cardboard TV box
persos.pose: standing on the right next to the empty cardboard box, calm

dialogue: Pourquoi tu as vendu ma télé-là ?!
Papa, c'est une avance sur mon héritage dêh.
Mais je suis pas encore mort !
Ya fohi. J'ai gardé le carton pour toi.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The father shouts, pointing at the empty stand. The son answers calmly. The father shouts, outraged. The son answers kindly, patting the empty cardboard box, his face clearly visible.
chute: The father freezes, staring at the cardboard box. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small studio apartment in Cocody, Abidjan, a bed, a mirror, a phone charger on the wall, morning light

persos.nom: the happy boyfriend with the phone
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, mint-green t-shirt, short twists, holding his phone up
persos.pose: standing on the left, showing his phone, very happy

persos.nom: the cold girlfriend with the sunglasses
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, cream trench coat, big round sunglasses on her head, a packed travel bag on her shoulder
persos.pose: standing on the right near the door, arms crossed, cold

dialogue: Bébé, tu m'as envoyé cinquante mille par erreur dêh !
C'est pas une erreur. C'est pour ton transport.
Hors de ma vie. Bon voyage !
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boyfriend shows his phone, delighted. The girlfriend answers coldly. The boyfriend asks, confused. The girlfriend answers with a big fake smile and waves goodbye, her face clearly visible.
chute: The boyfriend's happy smile slowly freezes, his phone still raised. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boyfriend's devastated face looking into the camera.
gag: LE GARS APRÈS LE « BON VOYAGE » :
